note: AD-136 (D9): the machinery of a building is the top of its own ladder, not a shared mechanics branch. A building of this type works its machine from the listed working level (that level itself needs the branch's research). bench: its workshop station turns without a worker; cycle: its own field cycle; dig: the adit or the quarry digs itself; haul: it takes one delivery of the village's logistics per turn; sort (AD-147): the warehouse keeps its store sorted by category (WarehouseSort), without couriers or wolves. A drive from the mill wheel (AD-055) still turns any workshop bench, at the fixed reach of research_knobs.json drive_fixed. legacy_level: the level of a farm that keeps the AD-104 field table.
